item.title: Kyoto Aquarium: River to Sea in Umekoji Park — Guide
item.description: The Kyoto Aquarium, opened in 2012 in Umekoji Park near Kyoto Station, is unusual for a large aquarium in being entirely inland, and it makes a virtue of it: the visit begins not with the sea but with the rivers of Kyoto, starring the giant Japanese salamander, a strange and ancient amphibian native to the region’s waterways. From there it moves through jellyfish tanks, a large open penguin and seal zone, a big tank recreating the seas off Kyoto, and a dolphin stadium with regular shows.
